description: An application frame with a collapsible sidebar on desktop and a floating tab bar on mobile.
overview:
`AppShell` builds navigation from an `items` array of `AppShellItem` objects and wraps your page content. On desktop it renders a `Sidebar` inside a `SidebarProvider`, with optional `header` and `footer`, group labels, badges, tooltips on collapsed icons and a `SidebarRail`; the page renders in a `SidebarInset`.

Below the `48rem` breakpoint the sidebar is replaced by a `TabBar` pinned to the bottom of the screen, and the content renders in a `main` element padded to clear it. Items that do not fit in the tab bar move behind its More trigger. Use it as the outermost layout of an app with a handful of top-level destinations.
usage:
Each `AppShellItem` has a `value`, `label` and `icon`, plus optional `href`, `badge`, `group` and `disabled`. Items with the same `group` render under a shared `SidebarGroupLabel`. The selected item is controlled with `value` and `onValueChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`; it defaults to the first item. Items with an `href` render through `render`, which defaults to a plain anchor, so you can pass your router's link component.

The sidebar accepts `variant` (`sidebar`, `floating` or `inset`), `collapsible` (`icon` by default, `offcanvas` or `none`), `side`, `rail`, and `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange` for its expanded state. `moreLabel` sets the tab bar's More trigger text. Place `AppShellTrigger` in your page header to toggle the sidebar.

examples.WithHeaderAndFooter: Adds a brand menu in the sidebar header and an account menu in the footer.
examples.Grouped: Splits items into labelled Platform and Workspace groups and disables one item.
examples.MoreTab: Uses eight items with `defaultValue` so extra items overflow into the mobile tab bar's More panel.
examples.Links: Gives every item an `href` so each renders as a link to its route.
examples.Offcanvas: Sets `collapsible` to `offcanvas` so collapsing slides the whole sidebar out of view.
examples.RightSide: Places the sidebar on the right with `side`.

parts.AppShell: The root layout that renders the sidebar or tab bar from `items` and wraps the page content.
parts.AppShellTrigger: A `SidebarTrigger` that toggles the sidebar on desktop and renders nothing on mobile.

accessibility:
- The selected item has `aria-current="page"`.
- Collapsed sidebar items show their label in a tooltip on hover.
- `AppShellTrigger` is labelled Toggle Sidebar, and `Cmd+B` on macOS or `Ctrl+B` elsewhere toggles the sidebar.
- With `collapsible="offcanvas"`, the hidden sidebar is removed from view and the tab order.
- Disabled items are disabled buttons.
notes: The sidebar exposes `data-state` (`expanded` or `collapsed`), `data-collapsible`, `data-variant` and `data-side` for styling. On mobile the wrapper carries `data-slot="app-shell"` and the content `data-slot="app-shell-content"`; `className` applies to the content area on both layouts. `rail` only renders when `collapsible` is not `none`.
